title: Audio Memo Mirrored Event
description: The inbox watcher dropped the reply's Earshot phone copy AFTER the replied fact went out. The replied fact is published once the watcher has decided who speaks the reply; when the phone's first drops all failed it says earshot_skipped=car_released (the take was given back so a car may play it). If no car claims the reply, the watcher keeps retrying the phone in the background (up to ~45 minutes) and, when a drop finally lands, publishes this fact so a consumer that read 'not mirrored to the phone' in replied learns the phone has it now. Published at most once per memo, only for a late drop (a phone copy made at the first decision is in the replied fact itself). Part of the voice memo journey: correlationid = data.memo_id and ordering_key 'memo:<memo_id>'. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md.

s3_key.description: Object key of the voice memo: inbox/<agent>/<yyyy>/<mm>/<dd>/<file>.

reply_s3_key.description: The car's copy of the reply (replies/...), which the Earshot copy was made from.

earshot_key.description: The object in the Earshot channel the phone plays.

earshot_text_key.description: The full reply text dropped beside the audio, when there is one.

rounds.description: How many background phone drops it took (0 when an earlier drop turned out to have landed).

after_release_seconds.description: Seconds from the release of the phone's take to the drop that landed.

earshot_skipped_before.description: What the replied fact said about the phone copy: car_released.

occurred_at.description: When the watcher published the fact (RFC 3339).
